title: Validate contact CSV imports before saving
description:
Today a bad row halfway through an upload aborts the import and leaves half the contacts saved (CRM-77). This adds a pure parsing/validation step that reports every problem with the spreadsheet line number, so the UI can show all errors at once and we only write when the whole file is valid.

- required columns: email, first_name, last_name (company and phone optional)
- emails are normalised to lower case and must be unique within the file
- files over 10,000 rows are rejected

Wiring it into the upload endpoint is the next PR.
